messages:
Maria Gomez: FYI postmortem follow-up 10 — ingestion delay on 2026-03-10 resulted in late tokens and several invoice adjustments. Need owners for fix, backfill, and customer comms.
Sanjay Patel: I'll own the consumer streaming patch. Root cause: checkpoint race under backpressure. Plan: canary deploy in 24h, full roll in 48h.
Liam O'Connor: I will handle reconciliation scripts. Once Sanjay provides sequence ranges Ill diff pre/post and validate no duplicates.
Alex Chen: Billing ops: need list of affected invoices + token deltas. I can produce provisional credits CSV once I get sequences.
Julie Park: I'll draft customer messaging templates (internal + public). Hold public note until we confirm dollar impact for top-tier accounts.
billing-bot: Incident INC-4723 created (severity: P2) (tagged: finance, eng).
Sanjay Patel: Note: backfill will support dry-run and rate limits to avoid CPU spikes. Adding temporary throttle at 50% QPS.
Alex Chen: Sample extraction query queued; will run against prod snapshot after sequence confirmation: SELECT invoice_id, customer_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens_sum FROM token_ledger WHERE seq BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY invoice_id, customer_id;
Liam O'Connor: Verification plan: baseline vs post-backfill per-customer token reconciliation, plus embedding consumption sanity checks. First report 72h after backfill completes.
Maria Gomez: Proposed timeline: patch canary 24h, full roll 48h, backfill plan 72h, invoice list 5 business days, credits & comms 7-10 business days.
Sanjay Patel: Acknowledged. Risk: backfill causing transient lag for live ingestion; mitigation: incremental windows + monitor.
Alex Chen: I'll tag journal entries with "INGEST-BACKFILL-INC-4723" and include suggested_credit_usd in CSV.
Julie Park: Support playbook: expedited manual credits for enterprise customers; hold messaging for accounts > $50k MRR until confirmation.
Maria Gomez: Recurring pattern: this is the 3rd similar ingestion lag in 9 months. Proposing a separate epic to harden checkpointing and GC interaction.
Liam O'Connor: I'll lead the 3-sprint mitigation audit and add unit/integration tests around retention/GC.
Sanjay Patel: I'll add new alerts: consumer queue lag > 5m and checkpoint latency > 500ms.
Alex Chen: Confirming I'll deliver invoice CSV within 5 business days.
Maria Gomez: Confirmed owners: Sanjay (patch/backfill), Liam (recon), Alex (invoices/credits), Julie (comms), Maria (postmortem + exec note). Meeting tomorrow 11:00am PT to sync.
All: Ack.
